sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy.
Home Deptt. Govt. Of U.P. Lko

. A
Counsel for Applicant :- Shamshad Ahmad Khan,Huma Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C (Now Section 529 of B.N.S.S., 2023) has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to expedite the proceedings of W.S. Criminal Case No.9325 of 2020; State vs. Saurabh Singh arising out of Case Crime No.146 of 2019 under Sections 498-A, 323,
504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Mahanagar,
District-Lucknow.
3.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the aforesaid innocuous prayer of the applicant.

4. Considering the aforesaid, this Court hopes and trusts that if there is no legal impediment, the trial court shall make an earnest endeavour to consider and decide the aforesaid case with expedition.
Monika Pal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.
